integrity: A finite exhaustive exact-arithmetic computation supports every claimed graph order and is included as a reproducible checker and complete exception-class census. No external independent validation has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected unweighted symmetric equal-patch networks only, with zero diagonal; spectral capacity is not an empirical persistence probability. All-parameter weighted/spatial habitat networks and seven-or-more-vertex classifications are not claimed. Historical priority for the exact small-order classifications has not been independently established, and two relevant early papers could not be examined in full.
title: Two sharp degree-rule failure thresholds in unweighted habitat capacity
